title: Goobermon
description: A (goofy) cobblemon modpack that brings life to both pokemon and minecraft aspects of the game.
body: A simple cobblemon (goofy, not so goofy) modpack that brings life to both aspects of the game (being pokemon and minecraft). Adds some vanilla plus experiences mixed with addons perfect for a relaxing cobblemon playing sessions (this is the goofiest sentence i have ever wrote). This is just a modpack i made to play with my (goober) friends. And now i like to share it with the rest of the (goofy) world.
